messages:
julia_s: quick heads-up  Prospect Nebula Labs wants to POC nebula-edge-20b:q2 in Private (on-prem). asks: catalog entry, variant compatibility, EKM/HSM support (they use Luna), licensing/export constraints, and a POC price estimate. can someone pick this up?

ben_ops: whos the contact and what's their expected workload?

julia_s: contact is marco@nebulalabs.ai. workload = edge deployment with many short chats + long context syncs (4k typical) and embeddings. they care about offline private infra and strict EKM flow.

presales-bot: initiating variant compatibility scan: job=nebula_q2_onprem_21. targets: onprem-vm-01 (intel+NVIDIA), checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, tokenization, hsm-workflow. ETA ~7m.

rajiv: note q2 quant uses 2-bit packing heuristics for weights; need to verify our on-prem kernel path supports the packing layout. I'll follow the scan and run a tokenization parity check.

infra-bot: scan complete. job=nebula_q2_onprem_21. summary: kernel path requires recent runtime (v2.8+) for 2-bit packing; KV-cache OK but memory overhead +14%; tokenization parity mismatch in 0.18% of prompts; HSM handshake flows require ops runbook for Luna. report: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/nebula_q2_onprem_21/report.html

ben_ops: non-blocking items. action items: 1) schedule runtime upgrade on their node (we can run a canary), 2) ops runbook for Luna EKM + key provisioning, 3) tokenization repro + patch if they want 100% parity. timeline: 3-5 business days for EKM integration w/ Luna vendor coordination.

clare_security: security checklist: we need SAML auth to their ops team, signed CN on HSM certs, and an audit log export to their SIEM. Also confirm export control on model weights (they asked about redistributing variant).

legal-bot: draft license note: "Nebula-edge-20b:q2 is provided under our enterprise model license. Customers may not redistribute model weights or variants; private inference permitted under enterprise terms. Export controls: customer must confirm destination country; additional export paperwork may be required." Please review / adapt.

julia_s: Marco also asked if we can do an A/B fallback to a smaller variant if memory spikes. what's our recommended fallback?

rajiv: fallback plan: route to nebula-edge-7b:fp16 as automatic fallback when p95 memory > threshold or runtime reports oiomem pressure. canary strategy: 10% traffic for 24h, monitor perf regressions, then widen. we have a ready policy in the console.

ben_ops: ops checklist for POC: runtime upgrade (v2.8+), deploy EKM runbook for Luna, configure KV-cache retention policy (default = fp16), and set fallback route to 7b. estimate: 3 business days to prepare env + 1 day smoke test.

julia_s: can someone paste a minimal failing prompt for the tokenization drift so Marco can test locally?

rajiv: dropping repro here:

```
# repro (triggers 1-token shift ~0.18% of cases on q2)
Prompt: \"Summarize: \\\"Edge device reported \\\"Temp=37C; reboot needed\\\"\\\" with nested quotes and special chars \\u2013 verify token boundaries\"
```

rajiv: I've got a patch branch (rt/nebula/q2-token-fix) that trims a corner-case in the tokenizer. we can push before POC if they demand exact parity.

clare_security: also confirm key rotation policy with Luna vendor (Marco's team wants 24h rotation for sessions). that will affect ops validation steps.

ben_ops: noted. 24h rotation increases validation surface but still doable; add +1 day for rotation tests if required.

julia_s: great. who will own the quote and the outreach to Marco? I'll draft the email but want a price line.

ben_ops: i'll send a sketch: POC compute (nebula-edge-20b:q2) daily usage line + one-time EKM integration/setup fee + optional canary support. will circulate by EOD tomorrow.

legal-bot: will prepare a short license clause and export checklist for the email.

julia_s: perfect. assigning: ben_ops = quote + ops schedule, rajiv = token-fix PR & repro, clare_security = finalize HSM checklist, legal-bot = license clause. i'll email Marco with the scan link and expected timelines. thanks team :thumbsup:

ben_ops: thanks — ping me if Marco wants a private call for the HSM handoff.

julia_s: closing thread for now, will reopen if Marco asks for more perf traces.
